PetProfile.title: PetProfile
PetProfile.description: Stores the user's 3D ChibiPet state, stats, appearance, streak freezes, and unlocked outfits.

petName.description: Custom name of the user's ChibiPet

speciesColor.description: Color palette theme of the 3D pet

coins.description: Spendable star coins earned from verified habits

totalCompleted.description: Total number of verified habit completions

streakFreezes.description: Owned streak freeze tokens (0-10) that protect missed habit days

lastDailyBonusDate.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) when the daily all-quests sweep bonus was claimed

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when pet profile was created (clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp())

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when pet profile was last updated (clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp())

Habit.title: Habit
Habit.description: A daily real-world habit tracked by the user and verified via Gemini Vision proof photos.

category.description: Habit category icon and verification hint

streakCount.description: Consecutive or cumulative habit streak count

lastVerifiedDate.description: ISO local date (YYYY-MM-DD) of last verified completion, or empty string

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when habit was created (clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp())

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when habit was updated (clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp())

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: Persistent conversation turn between the user and their ChibiPet companion.

habitTag.description: Optional habit context tag for milestone messages

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when message was stored (clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp())

PetCard.title: PetCard
PetCard.description: Shareable Buddy Card keyed by short buddy code for friend visits and playdates.

PetCheer.title: PetCheer
PetCheer.description: Cheering boop sent by a friend to a user's PetCard.

FriendLink.title: FriendLink
FriendLink.description: Saved accountability friend reference under the user's private friends subcollection.

UsageQuota.title: UsageQuota
UsageQuota.description: Tracks daily AI interactions (Vision, Chat, Studio), grace credits, Eco Lite preference, and quota reset dates in Firestore.

dateIso.description: ISO local date (YYYY-MM-DD) for the active daily quota window

visionUsed.description: Number of Gemini Vision habit proof checks used today

chatUsed.description: Number of Gemini companion chat replies used today

studioUsed.description: Number of Nano Banana / Flash-Lite Image studio generations used today

bonusGraceCredits.description: Bonus grace credits added for the current day

graceClaimed.description: Whether the one-time daily +3 grace credit boost was claimed today

ecoLiteMode.description: Whether Eco Lite Mode (Flash-Lite preference) is enabled

fallbackCascadeCount.description: Count of automatic fallback cascades to Flash-Lite models today

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the quota ledger was created (clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp())

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the quota ledger was last updated (clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp())

/users/{userId}/petProfile/{profileId}.description: User's single ChibiPet profile document (id: main).

/users/{userId}/habits/{habitId}.description: User's tracked habits and Gemini Vision proof streaks.

/users/{userId}/chatMessages/{messageId}.description: Persistent chat memory between the user and their ChibiPet.

/users/{userId}/usageQuota/{quotaId}.description: User's daily AI interaction quota ledger (id: daily).

/petCards/{cardId}.description: Lookup-by-code Buddy Cards for friend playdates.

/petCards/{cardId}/cheers/{cheerId}.description: Friend cheering boops sent to a Buddy Card.
